title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. I want to ask that is purchasing anything in installments under a finance scheme with zero percent intrest allowed in Islam? In these schemes I am not supposed to pay any intrest but the bank or the funding body does take some processing charges. 2147 views Q. Finance 2666 views Q. Assalamlikum I had a plot of 262 sq.ft., my elder brother told me sell this plot and buy another place (due to some litigation) & sold around Rs.4,97,800/- for this intention to buy another plot in a prime location, more than 6 years back. After selling my elder brother asked for hand loan & I gave hand loan (kharzi hasana) to him Rs.270000/- for 3 month commitment only. Till today I did not get back the money. Even I used hard words after the maturity. He has the money but he is not giving, investing in real estate and earning money with my money. & I am waiting when he will return back my money I will by the plot. Now the land prices are so high & increased 13 to 15 times more in this 6 years timne. Even which I sold the above plot price 15 times increased. Due to block this hand loan money I did not invest the amount in plot. If I invested above sold plot amount in another plot present value will be around Rs.75 to 80 lakhs will get. For this I have lost lakhs of rupees. So requesting to provide me a fatwa above my lakhs of rupees loses. Now how much I have to collect with him? Actual amount or actual amount plus loses. 1769 views Q. Please, say about the store or stock of Grain is right or not? Please, say about that business jaiz or najaiz? 1883 views Q. We have a grain store and we have given it on lease for 11 months. We get Rs 8000/- every month. 1649 views Q. I am working as a passport agent i deal with two types of customer,one a regular customer who is ready to recive his passportin nomal procedure without giving an extra amount. The other type of customer is who needs his passport urgently for his personal matter is ready to pay extra amount to the concerned person. Here I charge them a extra amount and i pay some part of the amount to the concerned persons to get his passport urgently and he gets it. So my exact question is that the extra amount which is paid by me to the concerned persons on his behalf is right or wrong and the remaining amount is jayaz to me or not? 1927 views Q. JAZAKALLAH. Question: Assalam alaikum kya islam mey BROKARING ka karobaar durust hai, kya. makanath dilana aur us par paisey lena. dallali, baraye meherbani tafshil sey boliyega. JAZAKALLAH. Answer ID: 7256 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1081/947=L/1429) It is alright, provided the wage is fixed. This is also permissible if the wage is fixed. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
